accessibility.description: If it is not accessible, it is not finished. WCAG 2.1 AA is the target from the first screen. Keyboard navigation, screen reader output and colour contrast are part of how each screen is built, not a pass added at the end.
accessibility.requirements: Semantic HTML | WCAG 2.1 AA compliance | Keyboard accessibility | Screen reader support | Reduced-motion support
accessibility.title: Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA

code.description: Your codebase is written for the next developer who opens it. Strict TypeScript catches a class of bugs manual testing misses, and a component-based structure lets a new developer trace a feature from route to page. The code you receive at handover is the code your next hire extends.
code.requirements: Strict TypeScript | Component-based architecture | Zero lint errors | Documented API endpoints
code.title: Code quality

performance.description: Speed is decided by the architecture, not by a late optimisation pass. Pages are served from a global edge network, images in modern formats, with only the JavaScript a page needs - all chosen before the first screen is built. Each threshold below is a target measured on a mobile profile.
performance.requirements: Edge delivery | Modern image formats | Minimal JavaScript | Optimised fonts
performance.title: Performance: Core Web Vitals

security.description: Security headers, input sanitisation and dependency audits are part of the build, not an afterthought. Authentication flows are built against current OWASP guidance. For stores and systems that take payments, this is the baseline.
security.requirements: CSP headers | Secure authentication | Sanitized inputs | Dependency audits
security.title: Security

enforcement.description: These are the targets Altruvex builds to. This site's own repository runs an automated version on every push and pull request: lint, type check, pricing validation, tests with a coverage threshold on the tested libraries, a production build and Lighthouse. Accessibility below 95 or SEO below 90 fails the run; performance is measured and reported.
enforcement.title: The targets we build to,
enforcement.titleItalic: and the checks this site runs on itself.
